Simply ensure that the **script** is listed first. This is mainly used for `tres`/`res` files. When retrieving **icon** and **resource_script_class**, we assume that the first dependency is the script it uses (not the scripts it holds).

If the resources are continuously modified later, the order will become even more disordered. Furthermore, recursive calls will also disrupt the order. If a resource is referenced multiple times.
